defined_graph_is_conservative_and_determ.reason: Negation is unsatisfiable over arbitrary nonempty individual domains
defined_graph_is_conservative_and_determ.formula:
(let ((a!1 (forall ((q_3 NoemaIndividual))
             (forall ((q_4 NoemaIndividual))
               (forall ((q_5 NoemaIndividual))
                 (=> (and (p_ja q_3)
                          (= q_4 (p_jb q_3))
                          (p_ja q_3)
                          (= q_5 (p_jb q_3)))
                     (= q_4 q_5)))))))
  (and (forall ((q_1 NoemaIndividual))
         (let ((a!1 (exists ((q_2 NoemaIndividual))
                      (and (p_ja q_1) (= q_2 (p_jb q_1))))))
           (= a!1 (p_ja q_1))))
       a!1))

      (a!2 (forall ((q_8 NoemaIndividual))
             (forall ((q_9 NoemaIndividual))
               (forall ((q_10 NoemaIndividual))
                 (=> (and (p_jc q_8 q_9) (p_jc q_8 q_10)) (= q_9 q_10))))))

  (=> (and a!1 a!2) a!3))
